status: Vector-window capture and resumable vector input now retain owned storage or detach borrowed batches; whole-window backend/output ownership remains open
contract: Window vector scanning prefers scanOwnedVectorBatches, including adapters exposing only that vector capability. Input handles remain retained after producer advancement and release when output closes.

Borrowed batches use detachOwnedBatch through the shared data detacher. Typed arrays, packed payload, nested vectors, dictionary indices and container data are admitted before copying. Shared dictionary/vector objects are copied once via a temporary admitted memo; the physical vector representation is preserved.
Existing row detachment keeps its original supported-data contract. Enabling vector typed storage does not make arbitrary typed arrays valid row values.
Non-resumable vector-window capture owns its batch directory, source storage and selection masks through output. Zero-match batches release temporary selection and source lifetimes promptly.

Resumable vector runs use scoped selection and owned materialization before transferring rows to the retained run buffer. Input, materialized output and detached run rows overlap under the same budget; cleanup releases all temporary handles.
Owned-versus-borrowed selection is automatic and requires no new configuration flag.

default.note: Production code unchanged after this run; two additional capability/shape test cases were then added and run in the final focused suite.

cases: Shared dictionaries and indices are copied once; mutation of borrowed strings, indices and numeric arrays does not alter detached output.
Exact measured detachment peak succeeds; cap-minus-one rejects and releases all reservations.
Ordinary and resumable spill windows preserve rows across reuse/mutation of the same borrowed vector batch.
Owned scan preference and owned-only capability are tested. An 8 KiB source backing allocation remains retained after producer close until output iterator return.
Nested, map, union, decimal, timestamp and packed physical shapes survive detachment; borrowed packed bytes can mutate without changing retained output.

Real Brotli Parquet HTTP 206 and ignored-Range 200 tests now exercise owned vector windows and resumable vector runs. Native local Worker R2 repeats them with 64/128 MiB pools, 2 MiB query caps, shared caches, successful expressions and oversized expansion rejection.

limits: Delegated executeWindowTasks results still need complete output ownership. The vector fixture adapter intentionally omits task execution to exercise the vector path.
Window backend copied rows, partition/sort/index structures, computed results, final collection, state parsing/chunking and checkpoint encoding remain partially or wholly unadmitted.
Resumable vector rows currently materialize into owned batches and then detach into the run buffer, adding bounded overlap. No CPU throughput improvement is claimed.
Borrowed-source backing created before delivery remains the adapter responsibility. Reservation bounds are not a total runtime heap or production Cloudflare certification.
Final release gates and the complete audit acceptance matrix remain open.
